explanation: Lemma 5.3 only rules out exact simultaneous attainment of the crude branch minimum with zero remainder; the flawed step is in Proposition 5's proof, which treats this strict nonattainment as enough to force the total lower bound positive. That inference is unjustified because a strict improvement over the negative bound \((w(v)-d(v))(k^2-k)\) need not be large enough to make \(E_v(x)>0\).
